name: Souls
source:
In Souls, you take the role of a 20 year old man who ends up being in a plane crash with various other women.

But somehow you forget everything you knew during the crash and gain the ability to hear what people are thinking.

This island you ended up on contains many mysteries and secrets as well as all the women you are stranded with!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/zversegames]Patreon[/url]]
